decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost extension of the established offer and supports the fast-response promise, but it overlaps with the other express programs and may be consolidated.

The seventy-two-hour program carries higher logistics costs and has only minimal website presence; slack in a large, growing firm lets it be carried while results are uncertain, though consolidation risk remains.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular system and was featured on the home page, so it fits the core business and meets aspirations.
The express program for doors and gates has its own page and serves as the umbrella for the delivery offers, so it is likely kept as the main express channel.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports trade partners and the firm's service strategy, and digital investments are rarely dropped within a year.
The fire and smoke protection door sits close to the certified core product line, where regulatory demand is stable, so there is no shortfall prompting search.
